IS THE X FEED CURRENT?
Newest post in the published feed: 2026-09-23 22:30Z · 1h ago — within the collector's two-hour rhythm.
17351 posts are stored in that feed in total; 1070 of them fall in the last 24 hours and 431 carried a word the list knows. The collector runs on Alan’s MacBook at 06:30, 08:30, 10:30, 12:30, 14:30, 16:30, 18:30, 21:00 and 23:30 ET and publishes the whole feed each time; this page only ever reads what it published.

HOW EACH VOICE IS MEASURED
YouTube. A scheduled job collects clips from the channels Alan subscribes to and from ticker searches, and files them in youtube_videos. For the subscribed channels it fetches the English transcript and counts finance keywords around each ticker mention — a word list with negation (yt-lexicon-v1), not an AI read — and writes one pooled row per ticker into social_sentiment over a 7-day window. The room’s own blend above reads the ticker-tagged clips’ titles instead, because it needs the channel behind each reading and the per-video table is empty.

WHAT THIS ROOM DOES NOT SEE
Options flow of our own, the exchange-wide 52-week high/low count (we now measure our own 364 names, which is not the same list CNN uses), advancing and declining volume (we count stocks, CNN weighs by volume), anything outside our 364-stock universe, and any market outside the US. The published gauges above are shown exactly as their publishers print them and are never mixed into one of our own numbers.
